units.source_text: 但是，它们是在又窄又暗的壶里出生、鸣叫、产卵，然后死去。

en.t: But they are born, chirp, lay eggs, and then die inside a narrow, dark jar.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，它们还能传宗接代地生存下去。

en.t: Even so, they can go on living, generation after generation.

units.source_text: 这比起养在笼中只能活短暂的一代就绝种，不是好得多吗？

en.t: Isn't that far better than being kept in a cage, living only one brief generation, and then dying out?

units.source_text: 这是不折不扣地在壶中度过的一生。

en.t: This is, in every sense, a life spent inside a jar.
One could truly say there is a whole world inside the jar.
